title: Fynkel lock file
description: `fynkel.lock.json` next to `fynkel.project.json` (blueprint §13.5): the runtime, tool, schema, document-format and importer versions the project was last written with. Tools compare it to their own build and refuse to work silently on a mismatch (never migrate on open); `fynkel project lock` rewrites it deliberately. `package:fynkel` ships one in the same shape whose `runtime` also names the store and the prebuilt libraries (ADR-0029 §4, one lock shape). Not a document: no id, no name.

version.description: The Rust runtime crates' version (`fynkel_core` and friends share one workspace version).

abiVersion.description: The C ABI / wire protocol version (`fynkel_contracts::ABI_VERSION`).

store.description: Where the prebuilt runtime libraries of this version are (ADR-0029 §4): a base URL, `{version}` replaced with `version`. `package:fynkel`'s lock carries it; a project's lock may name another store for the same version.

artifacts.description: Build target (`macos-arm64`, `ios-simulator-x64`, …) → the prebuilt runtime library under `store`. `sha256` null: not published, the hook builds from source.

schemaFingerprint.description: `fynkel_core::schema::schema_fingerprint()` — the wire/component schema the project's generated code and documents match.

documents.description: Document kind → the `formatVersion` this build reads and writes.

importers.description: Importer id → its version (the asset compiler fingerprint).
